responsibility: Declares the `rustc_middle` query set and their public `TyCtxt`-facing interface, specifying each query's key and value types, caching and incremental-compilation behavior, provider separation, and descriptive metadata that the generated query infrastructure uses to expose compiler services.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files that organize one semantic area, this one is crate-wide query declaration infrastructure: it uses the `rustc_queries!` macro to list queries, their keys/results/attributes, rather than defining the underlying domain models those queries operate on.
